row: Baba Blast! Animal & Dinosaur Videos for Kids

What do we say when things get tough? That’s right: I can do this! I can do this! And, you can do it!

Baba Blast models resilience for young viewers and inspires them to explore their natural world. Baba Blast helps move screen time to playtime and outdoor time! 

Through educational videos for preschoolers, toddlers, and kids who love dinosaurs, animals, music, and adventure. Explore dinosaur videos for kids, animal videos for kids, scavenger hunts, songs, movement, pretend play, and preschool learning designed for early childhood. Baba Blast and his trusty wand, the Blaster, lead fun, story-driven adventures with King Bobo and his mischievous gobos. Along the way, kids build confidence, empathy, curiosity, problem-solving skills, and perseverance. If your child loves dinos, animals, interactive learning, and family-friendly educational entertainment, Baba Blast is here to help them learn, grow, and bounce back strong.

Created by mental health advocate, Kyle Kittleson.
